title: Life Path Number 9: The Humanitarian
name: The Humanitarian
intro: Life Path 9 people are compassionate, generous and idealistic. They care about the world, forgive easily and inspire others to be kinder.
weaknesses: Can hold on to the past
love: In love, 9s are romantic and selfless and need a partner who shares their values.
career: Charity, healthcare, art, teaching or international work.
